title: Promote security knowledge from community to Microsoft layer
summary: Five security knowledge articles moved from the community layer to the Microsoft layer with minor content refinements to remove non-existent references and contribution prompts.
key_points: Security domain knowledge relocated from community to Microsoft layer through byte-for-byte file moves
Removed references to missing example files and removed contribution boilerplate text
Best practice guidance improved for temporary table data protection to clarify automatic cleanup behavior
One article kept in community layer pending domain review
No changes to article count or frontmatter configuration
quote: Pure `git mv` relocation of the SECURITY knowledge domain from the community layer to the Microsoft layer.
